result.rationale: totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50 users, limit 50), this yields 2 pages though only one exists, making showingLast false so the 'next' action navigates to offset 50 and fetches an empty members list. The correct formula would be ceil or floor((user_count-1)/limit)+1. Mechanism fully verifiable from the diff.
